mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Inventory (book_id, current_stock, safety_stock) VALUES (#{book_id}, #{current_stock}, #{safety_stock})
mapper.select: SELECT i.inventory_id, i.book_id, i.current_stock, i.safety_stock, b.title AS book_title, b.isbn, b.price FROM Inventory i JOIN Book b ON i.book_id = b.book_id ORDER BY i.book_id ASC
